notes: The global Editor guard defines one exact local Development APK configuration, pending the compiled package-lock approval gate.
The current source keeps the live package-lock approval switch false; generate, review, and return Unity's resolved lock for source pinning before any APK build.
Scheduled Android extraScriptingDefines and active or stored custom Build Profiles are rejected before compilation.
Scheduled Android target, subtarget, scenes, output, Development plus optional ShowBuiltPlayer, and AssetBundle manifest are exact and fail closed.
Native debug symbols are pinned to None; Android library projects, embedded packages, managed plugins, and manifest overrides are rejected.
No production identity, keystore, alias, password, provider SDK, Android plugin, or build artifact is bundled.
Unity must materialize and save ProjectSettings.asset, and a follow-up must pin and approve the resolved package lock, before local preflight can pass.
Unity compilation, self-test, Test Runner, APK, signing, native-library, and device evidence are not retained.
